_why: Shadow mode: these gates still evaluate and still log what they WOULD have blocked, but they do not block. Adopted 2026-08-23 from the ox-alpha-led review, to resolve keep-vs-retire with evidence instead of argument.
_expiry_is_the_point: Past 'until' these gates block again automatically. This repo's defining failure is that nothing is ever retired; an undated shadow window would become another permanent un-retired thing. Extending must be a deliberate diff.
_review_at_expiry: node scripts/gate-telemetry-report.mjs — any hook with zero would_block:true entries retires on evidence.
